name: Pearl Diver
glass: Pearl Diver glass or Tiki mug
preparation: Blend all ingredients with crushed ice until frothy.
Pour into a Pearl Diver glass or tiki mug.
Garnish lavishly with mint, orchid, and grated nutmeg.

name: Aku Aku
preparation: Strain into a tiki mug over crushed ice.

name: Nui Nui
preparation: Strain into a tiki mug over crushed ice.

name: Rum Barrel
preparation: Strain into a tiki mug over crushed ice.

name: Doctor Funk
preparation: Shake rum, lime, grenadine, and absinthe with ice.
Strain into a Collins glass over ice and top with soda.

name: Don's Beachcomber
preparation: Blend all ingredients with crushed ice.

name: Caribbean Punch
preparation: Strain into a tiki mug over crushed ice.

name: Saturn Variation
preparation: Strain into a tiki mug over crushed ice.
Garnish with lemon peel and cherry.

name: Mai Tai (Royal Hawaiian)

Garnish with mint and spent lime shell.

name: Beachcomber's Gold
preparation: Strain into a tiki mug over crushed ice.

name: Taboo

name: Cobra's Breath
preparation: Strain into a tiki mug over crushed ice.

name: Kon-Tiki
preparation: Strain into a tiki mug over crushed ice.

name: Shrunken Skull
preparation: Blend all ingredients with crushed ice.

name: Vicious Virgin
preparation: Strain into a tiki mug over crushed ice.

name: Navy Grog (Modern)
preparation: Shake rums, juices, and honey with ice.
Strain over crushed ice and top with soda.

name: Penicillin (Smoky)
preparation: Shake Scotch, lemon, and syrup with ice.

name: Chartreuse Swizzle (Yellow)
preparation: Build in a Collins glass with crushed ice.

name: Pisco Sour (Amargo)
preparation: Dry shake, then shake with ice.

name: Singapore Sling (Modern)
preparation: Shake all except bitters with ice.

name: Paloma (Smoky)

name: Irish Coffee (Modern)
preparation: Warm glass with whiskey, coffee, and syrup.
Float cream over the back of a spoon.

name: Apple Cider Mule
preparation: Build vodka and juices over ice.

name: Hot Toddy (Spiced Rum)
preparation: Combine rum, honey, and lemon in a mug.

name: Mulled Wine Spritz
preparation: Build over ice with juice and syrup.

name: Clarified Milk Punch
preparation: Curdle with milk and strain through coffee filter.

name: Potted Parrot
preparation: Strain into a sling glass filled with crushed ice.

name: Tradewinds
preparation: Flash-blend all ingredients with crushed ice and a few agitator cubes (3–4 seconds).
Open-pour into a zombie or tiki mug.
Garnish with lemon and an inside-out cocktail umbrella.

name: Chief Lapu Lapu
preparation: Pour unstrained into a large snifter and add more ice to fill.
Garnish with mint and a long lemon peel.

name: QB Cooler
preparation: Add all ingredients and about 120 ml crushed ice to a blender.
Pour unstrained into a double old-fashioned glass, top with more crushed ice, and garnish with mint.

name: Ancient Mariner
preparation: Strain into a double old-fashioned glass filled with crushed ice.
Garnish with mint and a scored lime wedge.

name: 151 Swizzle
preparation: Add all ingredients and about 240 ml crushed ice to a blender.
Flash-blend on high for no more than 5 seconds.
Pour unstrained into a tall swizzle cup, top with crushed ice, and dust with nutmeg.
